name: @aws-sdk/client-ses
description: AWS SDK for JavaScript Ses Client for Node.js, Browser and React Native

readme.summary: The README covers SDK-level concepts well but is generic to the entire AWS SDK v3 rather than specific to @aws-sdk/client-ses, with no SES-specific examples, configuration, or troubleshooting.
readme.top_issue: All examples and getting-started content reference DynamoDB, not SES — a user looking to send emails has no package-specific guidance whatsoever.

common_complaints: Package release ordering causing installation failures
sentiment.summary: Active project with responsive maintenance—3 recent issues resolved and released, but 2 open bugs including a lingering performance regression (12 comments) and newly triaged test failures suggest ongoing stability challenges.

red_flags: Some responses are brief and could be more detailed for complex issues
Lack of context in some replies might confuse new users
communication.summary: The maintainer responses are generally helpful, clear, and patient. They provide technical depth where necessary but sometimes lack detail or context that could benefit new contributors or users with less experience.
